citations.narrative:
The licensee did not have disposition dates recorded on APHIS form 7005 for six dogs that have left the facility. Not
recording the disposition dates on APHIS form 7005 doesn't allow APHIS officials to be able to easily track the dogs that
are leaving the facility. All disposition dates must be recorded on APHIS form 7005 in a timely manner. Correct starting on
7/1/26.

At least four adult dogs are not up to date on their distemper/parvo vaccinations. Not having all adult dogs up to date on
their distemper/parvo vaccinations doesn't ensure those dogs are adequately protected against those diseases that the
vaccine is supposed to protect against. All adult dogs must be vaccinated against distemper/parvo in accordance with a
schedule that is approved by the attending veterinarian. Correct by 8/1/26.

The adult dogs have been examined by the attending veterinarian in the past year and the population has been sampled
for heartworm and fecal parasites, but the licensee doesn't have any records or documentation of these exams or tests.
Not having documentation of all exams and records of all tests that are completed doesn't allow the APHIS inspector to
easily ensure the population is in good health. The dates and findings/results of the annual exams must be documented
and be available to the APHIS inspector to review during inspection. Correct starting on 7/1/26.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
End of report.
